data.name: AlHaneen
data.gender_notes: AlHaneen is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: AlHaneen is derived from the Arabic root h-n-n which signifies generosity and kindness. The name is mentioned in the Hadith as the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). It is also a title used for some of the wives of the Prophet (pbuh) and the name of a female companion of Imam Ali (as). The name AlHaneen carries the meaning “The Gracious, The Generous” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlHaneen usually hope their child will grow to embody the gracious, the generous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of generosity and kindness towards others.
data.etymology: AlHaneen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Gracious, The Generous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlHaneen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
